newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Shell to boost presence in Nigerian capital Abuja.
newsitem.headline: Shell to boost presence in Nigerian capital Abuja.

text.p: The Nigerian unit of Royal Dutch Shell Group's, which pumps about half the country's crude oil output, plans to raise its representation in the inland capital Abuja, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Shell currently has a liaison office in Abuja where the military government moved the federal capital to from Lagos about four years ago.
"We will be having a bigger presence in Abuja because the government has moved most of its business to Abuja," a Shell spokesman said.
Shell's headquarters remains in Lagos where the company occupies a multi-storey building near the city centre.
Last year the government ordered all ministries and its agencies to move their headquarters to Abuja.
These include state oil company NNPC, which has a majority stake in The Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria, the joint venture with Royal Dutch Shell Group.
